newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 28.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Chinese brokerages will take measures to strengthen risk control, including launching investigations into trading on credit by their subsidiaries.
- Turnover on the Shanghai stock exchange hit 804.9 billion yuan in the first three months of this year, about five times the amount in the same period last year.

- BUSINESS NEWS - A senior official with the State Planning Commission says encouraging state firms to raise money directly through the capital markets will help China to curb inflation by relieving the state of a huge credit burden.

- Fixed asset investment in China's western, interior areas increased by 35.4 percent year-on-year in the first quarter of this year, compared with rises of 17.9 percent and 12.39 percent in the central and eastern areas.
